   188	  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: no run state at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
   189	  if ! jq -e . "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "run-checkpoint: $file unparseable — no checkpoint; beads are the recovery truth" >&2; if (( json )); then echo '{"checkpoint":null,"reason":"unparseable"}'; fi; return 0; fi

   191	  sv=$(jq -r '.schema_version // 1' "$file"); cp=$(jq -c '.checkpoint // null' "$file")
   192	  [[ "$sv" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || sv=1
   193	  if [[ "$cp" == "null" || "$sv" -lt 2 ]]; then
   194	    if (( json )); then echo '{"checkpoint":null,"reason":"sprint granularity"}'; else echo "checkpoint: none (schema_version $sv → sprint granularity; resume at the first open bead of sprints.current)"; fi
   195	    return 0
   196	  fi
   197	  s=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.sprint // empty' "$file"); t=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.task // empty' "$file"); p=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.phase // empty' "$file"); ts=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.ts // empty' "$file")

   199	  elif [[ -n "$t" ]]; then
   200	    # A task checkpoint is trusted only when beads CONFIRMS the task closed;
   201	    # "br unavailable" is not a confirmation (Bridgebuilder PR #1269 FIND-003).
   202	    brc=0; bead_closed "$t" || brc=$?
   203	    case $brc in 0) ;; 2) reason="beads unavailable — task $t cannot be verified";; *) reason="task $t is not closed in beads";; esac
   204	  fi
   205	  if [[ -n "$reason" ]]; then
   206	    echo "run-checkpoint: discarding checkpoint ($reason) — resume from the first open bead of $s" >&2
   207	    if (( json )); then jq -cn --arg r "$reason" --arg s "$s" '{checkpoint:null, reason:$r, sprint:$s}'; else echo "checkpoint: discarded ($reason); resume at the first open bead of $s"; fi

   209	  fi
   210	  if (( json )); then jq -c '{checkpoint: .checkpoint}' "$file"
   211	  else echo "checkpoint: $s ${t:+task $t }phase $p at $ts → resume at the first open bead after $t in $s"; fi

   214	# fb_parse FILE GATE → one compact JSON object: {file, exists, trailer, verdict,
   215	# counts, exit_code, sprint_id, ts, approved, hash}. The hash is the run-mode
   216	# same-issue hash (md5 of `jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}'` over verdict-derive's
   217	# --json output; legacy files hash their findings section).
   218	fb_parse() {
   219	  local f="$1" g="$2" rel vj tl pj hash
   220	  rel="${f#"$root"/}"
   221	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then jq -nc --arg f "$rel" '{file: $f, exists: false}'; return 0; fi
   222	  vj=$(bash "$VERDICT_DERIVE" --file "$f" --gate "$g" --json 2>/dev/null) || true
   223	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$vj" || vj='{"trailer_found":false,"verdict":null,"counts":null,"exit_code":1}'
   224	  tl=$(grep -E '^<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$' "$f" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1) || tl=""
   225	  pj=$(printf '%s' "$tl" | sed -E 's/^<!-- LOA-VERDICT (.*) -->[[:space:]]*$/\1/')
   226	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$pj" || pj='{}'
   227	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.trailer_found' <<<"$vj")" == true ]]; then
   228	    hash=$(printf '%s\n' "$vj" | jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}' | _md5)
   229	  else
   230	    hash=$( { grep -A 100 "## Findings\|## Issues\|## Changes Required" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; } | head -50 | _md5)
   231	  fi
   232	  jq -nc --arg f "$rel" --argjson v "$vj" --argjson p "$pj" --arg h "$hash" '
   233	    def sid: if type == "string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$") then . else null end;
   234	    def tsv: if type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$") then . else null end;
   235	    {file: $f, exists: true, trailer: ($v.trailer_found == true),
   236	     verdict: ($v.verdict | if type == "string" then . else null end),
   237	     counts: ($v.counts // null), exit_code: ($v.exit_code // 1),
   238	     sprint_id: ($p.sprint_id | sid), ts: ($p.ts | tsv), hash: $h}
   239	    | .approved = (.exit_code == 0 and .verdict == "APPROVED")'
   240	}

   242	# impl_commit SINCE → "sha epoch" of the newest non-merge commit on HEAD since
   243	# SINCE touching a path outside the state/generated set, or nothing
   244	impl_commit() {
   245	  git -C "$root" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
   246	  git -C "$root" log --no-merges -n 1 --format='%H %ct' ${1:+"--since=$1"} -- . \
   247	    ':(exclude,glob)grimoires/**' ':(exclude,glob).run/**' ':(exclude,glob)**/REPO-MAP.md' \
   248	    ':(exclude,glob)**/checksums.json' ':(exclude,glob)**/CHANGELOG.md' 2>/dev/null || true
   249	}

   251	# The ordered rounds of one sprint directory: every -rN file, then the current
   252	# file unless it is byte-identical to the highest -rN of its gate
   253	rounds_of() {
   254	  local dir="$1" g base f n top topn cur
   255	  for g in review audit; do
   256	    if [[ "$g" == review ]]; then base=engineer-feedback; else base=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
   257	    top=""; topn=-1
   258	    for f in "$dir/$base"-r*.md; do
   259	      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   260	      n=${f##*-r}; n=${n%.md}
   261	      [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}$ ]] || continue
   262	      fb_parse "$f" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" --argjson n "$((10#$n))" '. + {gate: $g, round: $n}'
   263	      if (( 10#$n > topn )); then topn=$((10#$n)); top="$f"; fi
   264	    done
   265	    cur="$dir/$base.md"
   266	    if [[ -f "$cur" ]] && ! { [[ -n "$top" ]] && cmp -s "$cur" "$top"; }; then
   267	      fb_parse "$cur" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" '. + {gate: $g, round: 999999}'
   268	    fi
   269	  done
   270	}

   272	# Shared jq definitions: time, the breaker recompute and the run-state resolution
   273	JQ_DEFS='
   274	def epoch: if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
   275	def fresh($now; $win): epoch as $t | $t != null and ($now - $t) <= $win and ($t - $now) <= 300;
   276	def recompute($rounds; $reset):
   277	  ($rounds
   278	   | map(select($reset == null or ((.ts // "") > $reset)))
   279	   | sort_by([(.ts // ""), .round, (if .gate == "review" then 0 else 1 end)])
   280	   | map(select(.approved | not))) as $nr
   281	  | reduce $nr[] as $r ({cycle: 0, same: 0, hash: null, np: 0, lc: null};
   282	      .cycle += 1
   283	      | (if $r.hash != "none" and $r.hash == .hash then .same += 1 else .same = 1 | .hash = $r.hash end)
   284	      | ($r.counts | tojson) as $c
   285	      | (if .lc != null and .lc == $c then .np += 1 else .np = 0 end)
   286	      | .lc = $c);
   287	def skeleton($th; $ts):
   288	  {state: "CLOSED",
   289	   triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: $th.same, last_hash: null},
   290	              no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: $th.np},
   291	              cycle_count: {current: 0, limit: $th.cycles},
   292	              timeout: {started: $ts, limit_hours: $th.hours}},
   293	   history: []};
   294	def merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts):
   295	  (if type == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
   296	  | .triggers = (.triggers // {})
   297	  | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ([(.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0), $rc.cycle] | max)
   298	  | (if $rc.same > (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0)
   299	     then .triggers.same_issue.count = $rc.same | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $rc.hash else . end)
   300	  | (if $rc.np > (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) or (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts == null and $rc.lc != null)
   301	     then .triggers.no_progress.count = ([(.triggers.no_progress.count // 0), $rc.np] | max)
   302	          | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $rc.lc else . end)
   303	  | ( if (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
   304	        then ["same_issue", "same issue hash repeated \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times (derived from the feedback history)"]
   305	      elif (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
   306	        then ["no_progress", "counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
   307	      elif (.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
   308	        then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
   309	      else null end ) as $trip
   310	  | if $trip != null and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
   311	    then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], source: "derive"}])
   312	    else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end;
   313	def known_ids: (.derivation.sprint_ids // null) // ((.sprints.list // []) | map(.id? // empty));
   314	def resolve($f; $now; $win):
   315	  . as $c
   316	  | (if ($c | type) == "object" then $c else {} end) as $c
   317	  | ($c.state // $c.status // "") as $cs
   318	  | ($c | known_ids) as $known
   319	  | ([$f.sprints[] | select(.state != "complete")
   320	      | "sprint-\(.global_id)" as $g | .local_label as $l
   321	      | select(($known | index($g)) == null and ($l == "" or ($known | index($l)) == null))] | length > 0) as $new
   322	  | ((($c.completion // {}) | .merged_sha? // "") | type == "string" and length > 0) as $merged
   323	  | if ($c.state // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or ($c.status // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or $merged then "JACKED_OUT"
   324	    elif $f.breaker_open or $cs == "HALTED" then "HALTED"
   325	    elif $f.all_complete then "COMPLETE"
   326	    elif $cs == "COMPLETE" and ($new | not) then "COMPLETE"
   327	    elif ($c.timestamps.last_activity? // null) | fresh($now; $win) then "RUNNING"
   328	    else "INTERRUPTED" end;
   329	'

   331	cmd_derive() {
   332	  local ledger="$root/grimoires/loa/ledger.json" a2a="$root/grimoires/loa/a2a" active rows
   333	  if [[ ! -f "$ledger" ]] || ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   334	    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: no readable ledger at $ledger — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
   335	  fi
   336	  active=$(jq -r '.active_cycle // empty | strings' "$ledger")
   337	  if [[ -z "$active" ]] || ! jq -e --arg c "$active" 'any(.cycles[]?; .id == $c)' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   338	    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: the ledger has no active cycle — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
   339	  fi
   340	  local win now now_ts fa=1 th
   341	  win=$(( $(cfg_int '.run_mode.stale_hours' 12 8760) * 3600 ))
   342	  [[ "$(cfg '.run_mode.file_authoritative')" == false ]] && fa=0
   343	  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
   344	              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
   345	              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
   346	              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
   347	              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
   348	  now=$(date +%s); now_ts=$(now_iso)
   349	
   350	  # Per-sprint facts
   351	  local sprints="[]" gid label lstatus since dir rv au mex msid ic sj
   352	  rows=$(jq -r --arg c "$active" '
   353	    (.cycles[] | select(.id == $c)) as $cy
   354	    | ($cy.sprints // [])[]
   355	    | select((.global_id | type) == "number")
   356	    | [(.global_id | tostring), ((.local_label // "") | tostring), ((.status // "") | tostring),
   357	       ([.started, .created, $cy.created] | map(select(type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-")))
   358	        | if length == 0 then "" else ([.[0], ($cy.created // "")] | max) end)]
   359	    | map(if . == "" then "-" else . end)
   360	    | @tsv' "$ledger")
   361	  # "-" stands for an empty field: IFS whitespace (tab) would collapse two adjacent separators
   362	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r gid label lstatus since; do
   363	    [[ "$gid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
   364	    [[ "$label" == - ]] && label=""
   365	    [[ "$since" == - ]] && since=""
   366	    [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ ]] || label=""
   367	    [[ "$lstatus" =~ ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ ]] || lstatus="unknown"
   368	    [[ "$since" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$ ]] || since=""
   369	    dir="$a2a/sprint-$gid"
   370	    rv=$(fb_parse "$dir/engineer-feedback.md" review)
   371	    au=$(fb_parse "$dir/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" audit)
   372	    mex=false; msid=""
   373	    if [[ -f "$dir/COMPLETED" ]]; then
   374	      mex=true
   375	      msid=$(sed -n 's/^sprint:[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9._-]*\).*/\1/p' "$dir/COMPLETED" | head -n 1) || msid=""
   376	    fi
   377	    ic=$(impl_commit "$since")
   378	    sj=$(jq -nc --argjson gid "$gid" --arg label "$label" --arg status "$lstatus" --argjson rv "$rv" --argjson au "$au" \
   379	              --argjson mex "$mex" --arg msid "$msid" --arg ic "$ic" '
   380	      def mine: type == "string" and length > 0 and (. == "sprint-\($gid)" or ($label != "" and . == $label));
   381	      ($rv.approved == true and ($rv.sprint_id | mine)) as $R
   382	      | ($au.approved == true and ($au.sprint_id | mine)) as $A
   383	      | ([$rv.sprint_id, $au.sprint_id, (if $msid == "" then null else $msid end)] | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0))) as $ids
   384	      | ($mex and any($ids[]; mine | not)) as $stale
   385	      | ($mex and ($stale | not) and (($rv.sprint_id | mine) or ($au.sprint_id | mine))) as $M
   386	      | ($ic | split(" ")) as $c
   387	      | ([$rv.ts, $au.ts] | map(select(. != null)) | max) as $vts
   388	      | def verdict($x): if $x.exists then {verdict: $x.verdict, sprint_id: $x.sprint_id, consistent: ($x.exit_code == 0), file: $x.file} else null end;
   389	      {global_id: $gid, local_label: $label, status: $status,
   390	       completed_marker: $M, marker_present: $mex, stale_marker: $stale,
   391	       review: verdict($rv), audit: verdict($au),
   392	       impl_commit: (if ($c | length) == 2 then $c[0] else null end),
   393	       commit_after_verdict: (if ($c | length) == 2 and $vts != null
   394	                              then (($c[1] | tonumber) > ($vts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch 0)) else null end),
   395	       legacy_feedback: ([$rv, $au] | map(select(.exists and (.trailer | not)) | .file)),
   396	       state: (if $M and $R and $A and $status == "completed" then "complete"
   397	               elif ($M | not) and $R and $A then "awaiting_marker" else "in_progress" end)}')
   398	    sprints=$(jq -c --argjson s "$sj" '. + [$s]' <<<"$sprints")
   399	  done <<<"$rows"
   400	
   401	  # Breaker recompute over the active sprint's ordered rounds
   402	  local active_gid rounds cache="null" cache_ok=1 bcache="null" reset rc merged
   403	  active_gid=$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "" else ((map(select(.state != "complete")) | .[0]) // .[-1]) | .global_id | tostring end' <<<"$sprints")

   406	    rounds=$(rounds_of "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" | jq -sc '.')
   407	  fi
   408	  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
   409	    if cache=$(jq -c . "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [[ -n "$cache" ]]; then :; else cache="null"; cache_ok=0; fi

   411	  if [[ -f "$breaker" ]]; then bcache=$(jq -c 'if type == "object" then . else null end' "$breaker" 2>/dev/null) || bcache="null"; [[ -n "$bcache" ]] || bcache="null"; fi
   412	  reset=$(jq -c '.reset_at? // null | if type == "string" then . else null end' <<<"$bcache")
   413	  rc=$(jq -nc --argjson r "$rounds" --argjson z "$reset" "$JQ_DEFS"' recompute($r; $z)')
   414	  merged=$(jq -c --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' <<<"$bcache")
   415	
   416	  local facts report
   417	  facts=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$sprints" --argjson b "$merged" '
   418	    {sprints: $s,
   419	     all_complete: (($s | length) > 0 and all($s[]; .state == "complete")),
   420	     breaker_open: ($b.state == "OPEN"),
   421	     stale_markers: [$s[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id)"],
   422	     legacy_feedback: [$s[] | .legacy_feedback[]],
   423	     sprint_ids: [$s[] | "sprint-\(.global_id)"]}')

   425	                  --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" --arg cycle "$active" \
   426	                  --argjson fa "$fa" --argjson cache_ok "$cache_ok" --arg ag "$active_gid" "$JQ_DEFS"'
   427	    def st: if type == "string" then (if test("^[A-Z_]{1,32}$") then . else "INVALID" end) else null end;

   429	    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.state | st) else null end) as $cs
   430	    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.status | st) else null end) as $cst
   431	    | {cycle: $cycle, derived_at: $ts, stale_hours: ($win / 3600), file_authoritative: ($fa == 1),
   432	       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,
   433	       cache: (if $cache_ok == 0 then "unparseable" elif $c == null then "missing" else "present" end),
   434	       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
   435	       notes: ([
   436	         (if $cs != null and $cst != null and $cs != $cst then "cache .state \($cs) and .status \($cst) disagree" else empty end),
   437	         (if $s == "JACKED_OUT" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "JACKED_OUT is terminal: files show incomplete sprints; the cache is kept" else empty end),
   438	         (if $s == "COMPLETE" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "COMPLETE kept: no new incomplete sprint in the ledger" else empty end),
   439	         ($f.sprints[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id): COMPLETED marker names another sp

commands.name: deep-research
commands.description: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. (dynamic workflow)

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for this session and help diagnose issues

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's review recipe covers them) at the given effort level (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings up to many, some of them uncertain); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Research and plan a large-scale change, then execute it in parallel across 5–30 isolated worktree agents that each open a PR.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
commands.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Health-check the user's Claude Code setup and fix issues: diagnose installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover — from local data (duplicate or leftover installs, PATH, unparseable settings files, broken or colliding agent definitions, skills whose frontmatter fails to parse); find unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost and disable dead weight; deduplicate local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones; trim checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content a session could derive from the codebase (directory layouts, tech-stack lists, architecture overviews) while keeping gotchas, rationale, and non-standard conventions; migrate always-loaded CLAUDE.md guidance into lazy skills and nested CLAUDE.md files; flag slow hooks and context-heavy extensions; check the installed version is current; make auto mode the default permission mode; and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace.

commands.name: claude-api
commands.description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

commands.name: workflow-authoring
commands.description: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

commands.name: run-skill-generator
commands.description: Author or improve the run-<unit> skill - a per-project skill that tells agents how to build, launch, and drive this project's app. Use when the user asks to set up the project, get it running, write run instructions, or verify build/run steps work from a clean environment.

commands.name: plugin-authoring
commands.description: Make a mod: a change to Claude's own interface or behaviour, such as a live pane or panel, a band above the prompt, a status line, a toast, a slash command, or a hook on tool calls or prompts. Use to make, change or debug a mod or its hooks module.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# run-checkpoint.sh — run position in .run/ (cycle-125 FR-3, SDD D-3.2;
4	# cycle-129 FR-4(f)/FR-5, SDD D-4.6, D-5.1 … D-5.4). Beads are the task ledger;
5	# the checkpoint is a HINT; the run state and the breaker are caches DERIVED
6	# from files (COMPLETED markers, LOA-VERDICT trailers, the ledger, git).
7	#
8	#   run-checkpoint.sh write --sprint sprint-N --phase PHASE [--task BEAD-ID] [--file F]
9	#       Atomically sets .schema_version = 2, .checkpoint = {sprint, task, phase, ts}
10	#       and .timestamps.last_activity = ts: jq → F.tmp.$$ → mv -f, under flock
11	#       on F.lock. F must already exist (a run in progress). Then runs
12	#       `derive --write` (a missing ledger is skipped). Exit 0 · 2 usage /
13	#       no run · 3 write failed (the previous file is untouched).
14	#   run-checkpoint.sh read [--file F] [--json]
15	#       Prints the checkpoint when it is trustworthy: parses, and when a task
16	#       is named, `br show <task> --json` reports it closed (a checkpoint that
17	#       names an open or unknown bead is DISCARDED with a logged line — beads
18	#       remain the recovery source). schema_version 1 / no checkpoint → prints
19	#       "sprint granularity". Exit 0 always when F exists; 2 when it does not.
20	#   run-checkpoint.sh derive [--json] [--write] [--root DIR] [--file F]
21	#       For the ledger's active cycle, per sprint: global_id, local_label,
22	#       ledger status, completed_marker (a2a/sprint-<gid>/COMPLETED exists and
23	#       the feedback trailers name this sprint, as sprint-<gid> or the local
24	#       label; a trailer or a `sprint:` line naming another sprint makes it a
25	#       stale_marker, treated as absent), review/audit verdicts (verdict-derive.sh;
26	#       APPROVED needs exit 0; a file without a trailer is legacy: no verdict,
27	#       listed in derivation.legacy_feedback), impl_commit (newest non-merge
28	#       commit on HEAD since max(sprint started|created, cycle created) touching
29	#       a path outside grimoires/, .run/, REPO-MAP.md, checksums.json,
30	#       CHANGELOG.md) and state complete | awaiting_marker | in_progress.
31	#       Run state, first match wins:
32	#         cache .state or .status JACKED_OUT, or .completion.merged_sha → JACKED_OUT (terminal)
33	#         breaker OPEN, or cache HALTED                                 → HALTED (sticky until /run-resume)
34	#         every sprint complete                                         → COMPLETE
35	#         cache COMPLETE and the ledger registers no new incomplete sprint → COMPLETE
36	#         last_activity within run_mode.stale_hours (12)                → RUNNING
37	#         otherwise                                                     → INTERRUPTED
38	#       Breaker (active sprint = first incomplete, else the last): the ordered
39	#       rounds engineer-feedback-r*.md, auditor-sprint-feedback-r*.md and the
40	#       current files (sorted by trailer ts, round, gate; rounds before the
41	#       breaker's reset_at are ignored) give cycle_count (non-APPROVED rounds),
42	#       same_issue (consecutive equal hashes) and no_progress (consecutive
43	#       equal counts); each cached counter is raised to its recomputed value,
44	#       never lowered; OPEN when a count threshold is met (timeout is left to
45	#       record-round). --json prints the derivation; --write rewrites F
46	#       (.state canonical, .status mirrored, derived_at, derivation {source,
47	#       stale_markers, legacy_feedback, sprint_ids}; schema_version kept) and
48	#       the breaker, under their locks — only when F exists, parses, and
49	#       run_mode.file_authoritative is not false (false = report-only).
50	#       Exit 0 · 4 no ledger / no active cycle · 2 usage.
51	#   run-checkpoint.sh record-round --gate review|audit --file FEEDBACK [--sprint sprint-N]
52	#                                  [--state-file F] [--breaker B]
53	#       After a review or audit: verdict-derive.sh --json on FEEDBACK; the
54	#       same-issue hash is md5 of `jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}'` of that output
55	#       (no trailer: md5 of the first 50 lines from ## Findings / ## Issues /
56	#       ## Changes Required). APPROVED (exit 0) leaves every counter as is.
57	#       Otherwise, atomically on B: same_issue +1 when the hash equals
58	#       last_hash, else count 1 and last_hash = hash; no_progress +1 when the
59	#       counts equal the previous round's, else 0; cycle_count.current +1; then
60	#       the triggers in order same_issue ≥ threshold, no_progress ≥ threshold,
61	#       cycle_count ≥ limit, timeout (now - started ≥ limit_hours). A trip sets
62	#       state OPEN, appends history {timestamp, trigger, reason, gate, sprint},
63	#       sets F (.run/state.json) .state = HALTED, prints
64	#       `TRIPPED: <trigger>: <reason>` and exits 10 (also when B is already OPEN).
65	#       Exit 0 recorded · 2 usage / missing file · 3 write failed · 10 tripped.
66	#   run-checkpoint.sh mark --skill implement|bug --sprint ID [--root DIR]
67	#       Writes .run/implement-active.json {skill, sprint, started_at} (the
68	#       implement gate's marker sanction, valid two hours), then runs
69	#       `derive --write` when F exists. `unmark` removes the marker. Exit 0 · 2 usage.
70	#
71	# Default F: $LOA_RUN_DIR/sprint-plan-state.json, else <root>/.run/sprint-plan-state.json
72	# (--root DIR sets <root> and ignores LOA_RUN_DIR). B: <run dir>/circuit-breaker.json.
73	# Readers accept schema_version 1 and 2 and files without derived_at/derivation.
74	# Config (<root>/.loa.config.yaml, yq; absent = defaults): run_mode.stale_hours (12),
75	# run_mode.file_authoritative (true), run_mode.circuit_breaker.{same_issue,no_progress}_threshold
76	# (3, 5), run_mode.defaults.{max_cycles,timeout_hours} (20, 8) for a new breaker file.
77	# =============================================================================
78	set -euo pipefail
79	export LC_ALL=C
80	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
81	VERDICT_DERIVE="$SCRIPT_DIR/verdict-derive.sh"
82	usage() { sed -n '3,/^# Default F/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
83	
84	sub="${1:-}"; [[ -n "$sub" ]] || usage; shift
85	file="" sprint="" task="" phase="" json=0 write=0 root="" gate="" state_file="" breaker="" skill=""
86	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
87	  case "$1" in
88	    --file)   [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || usage; file="$2"; shift 2 ;;
89	    --sprint) [[ $# -ge 2 && "$2" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]] || usage; sprint="$2"; shift 2 ;;
90	    --task)   [[ $# -ge 2 && "$2" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]] || usage; task="$2"; shift 2 ;;
91	    --phase)  [[ $# -ge 2 && "$2" =~ ^[A-Z_]+$ ]] || usage; phase="$2"; shift 2 ;;
92	    --json)   json=1; shift ;;
93	    --write)  write=1; shift ;;
94	    --root)   [[ $# -ge 2 && -d "${2:-}" ]] || usage; root="$(cd "$2" && pwd)"; shift 2 ;;
95	    --gate)   [[ $# -ge 2 && ( "$2" == review || "$2" == audit ) ]] || usage; gate="$2"; shift 2 ;;
96	    --state-file|--file-state) [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || usage; state_file="$2"; shift 2 ;;
97	    --breaker) [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || usage; breaker="$2"; shift 2 ;;
98	    --skill)  [[ $# -ge 2 && ( "$2" == implement || "$2" == bug ) ]] || usage; skill="$2"; shift 2 ;;
99	    *) usage ;;
100	  esac
101	done
102	
103	# Root and run dir: --root wins (and pins the run dir under it); else the
104	# directory holding a --file that sits in a .run/ dir (write/read/derive only);
105	# else this script's checkout with $LOA_RUN_DIR honoured.
106	if [[ -n "$root" ]]; then
107	  run_dir="$root/.run"
108	else
109	  root="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
110	  run_dir="${LOA_RUN_DIR:-$root/.run}"
111	  if [[ -n "$file" && "$sub" != record-round ]]; then
112	    fdir="$(cd "$(dirname "$file")" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || fdir=""
113	    if [[ -n "$fdir" && "$(basename "$fdir")" == .run ]]; then root="$(dirname "$fdir")"; run_dir="$fdir"; fi
114	  fi
115	fi
116	if [[ "$sub" != record-round && -z "$file" ]]; then file="$run_dir/sprint-plan-state.json"; fi
117	[[ -n "$breaker" ]] || breaker="$run_dir/circuit-breaker.json"
118	[[ -n "$state_file" ]] || state_file="$run_dir/state.json"
119	CONFIG="$root/.loa.config.yaml"
120	
121	now_iso() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }
122	
123	# cfg KEY → the raw yq value ("null" when absent or unreadable). yq's `//`
124	# treats false as absent, so callers compare the raw text.
125	cfg() {
126	  local v
127	  if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ -f "$CONFIG" ]]; then
128	    v=$(yq "$1" "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null) || v="null"
129	    printf '%s' "${v//\"/}"
130	  else
131	    printf 'null'
132	  fi
133	}
134	cfg_int() {  # KEY DEFAULT MAX → a positive integer ≤ MAX, else DEFAULT
135	  local v; v=$(cfg "$1")
136	  if [[ "$v" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( v > 0 && v <= $3 )); then printf '%s' "$v"; else printf '%s' "$2"; fi
137	}
138	
139	_md5() { if command -v md5sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1; else md5 -q; fi; }
140	
141	# atomic_update FILE JQ-ARGS... — jq over FILE (or {} when FILE is absent) →
142	# FILE.tmp.$$ → mv -f, under flock on FILE.lock. Exit 3 on any failure; the
143	# previous file is untouched.
144	atomic_update() {
145	  local f="$1"; shift
146	  local tmp="$f.tmp.$$" rc=0
147	  (
148	    # flock is util-linux (Linux); without it (macOS) the write is still atomic
149	    # (tmp + mv) but concurrent writers may interleave — last writer wins.
150	    if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then flock -w 5 9 || { echo "run-checkpoint: lock timeout on $f.lock" >&2; exit 3; }; fi
151	    if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
152	      jq "$@" "$f" > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: $f is not valid JSON — not written" >&2; exit 3; }
153	    else
154	      jq "$@" <<<'{}' > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: could not build $f" >&2; exit 3; }
155	    fi
156	    jq -e . "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: refusing to replace $f with unparseable output" >&2; exit 3; }
157	    mv -f -- "$tmp" "$f"
158	  ) 9>"$f.lock" || rc=$?
159	  return $rc
160	}
161	
162	cmd_write() {
163	  [[ -n "$sprint" && -n "$phase" ]] || usage
164	  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: no run state at $file (start a run first)" >&2; return 2; fi
165	  local ts rc=0
166	  ts=$(now_iso)
167	  atomic_update "$file" --arg s "$sprint" --arg t "$task" --arg p "$phase" --arg ts "$ts" \
168	    '.schema_version = 2
169	     | .checkpoint = {sprint: $s, task: (if $t == "" then null else $t end), phase: $p, ts: $ts}
170	     | .timestamps = ((.timestamps // {}) + {last_activity: $ts})' || rc=$?
171	  (( rc == 0 )) || return $rc
172	  # Every checkpoint refreshes the derived caches (D-5.2); a missing ledger (4) is not an error here
173	  local err drc=0
174	  err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
175	  if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
176	  return 0
177	}
178	
179	bead_closed() {  # $1 bead id → 0 when br reports closed
180	  command -v br >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 2
181	  local js st
182	  js=$(br show "$1" --json 2>/dev/null) || return 1
183	  st=$(printf '%s' "$js" | jq -r 'if type=="array" then .[0] else . end | .status // .issue.status // empty' 2>/dev/null) || return 1
184	  [[ "$st" == "closed" ]]
185	}
186	
187	cmd_read() {
188	  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: no run state at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
189	  if ! jq -e . "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "run-checkpoint: $file unparseable — no checkpoint; beads are the recovery truth" >&2; if (( json )); then echo '{"checkpoint":null,"reason":"unparseable"}'; fi; return 0; fi
190	  local sv cp s t p ts reason="" brc
191	  sv=$(jq -r '.schema_version // 1' "$file"); cp=$(jq -c '.checkpoint // null' "$file")
192	  [[ "$sv" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || sv=1
193	  if [[ "$cp" == "null" || "$sv" -lt 2 ]]; then
194	    if (( json )); then echo '{"checkpoint":null,"reason":"sprint granularity"}'; else echo "checkpoint: none (schema_version $sv → sprint granularity; resume at the first open bead of sprints.current)"; fi
195	    return 0
196	  fi
197	  s=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.sprint // empty' "$file"); t=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.task // empty' "$file"); p=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.phase // empty' "$file"); ts=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.ts // empty' "$file")
198	  if [[ -z "$s" || -z "$p" ]]; then reason="malformed checkpoint"
199	  elif [[ -n "$t" ]]; then
200	    # A task checkpoint is trusted only when beads CONFIRMS the task closed;
201	    # "br unavailable" is not a confirmation (Bridgebuilder PR #1269 FIND-003).
202	    brc=0; bead_closed "$t" || brc=$?
203	    case $brc in 0) ;; 2) reason="beads unavailable — task $t cannot be verified";; *) reason="task $t is not closed in beads";; esac
204	  fi
205	  if [[ -n "$reason" ]]; then
206	    echo "run-checkpoint: discarding checkpoint ($reason) — resume from the first open bead of $s" >&2
207	    if (( json )); then jq -cn --arg r "$reason" --arg s "$s" '{checkpoint:null, reason:$r, sprint:$s}'; else echo "checkpoint: discarded ($reason); resume at the first open bead of $s"; fi
208	    return 0
209	  fi
210	  if (( json )); then jq -c '{checkpoint: .checkpoint}' "$file"
211	  else echo "checkpoint: $s ${t:+task $t }phase $p at $ts → resume at the first open bead after $t in $s"; fi
212	}
213	
214	# fb_parse FILE GATE → one compact JSON object: {file, exists, trailer, verdict,
215	# counts, exit_code, sprint_id, ts, approved, hash}. The hash is the run-mode
216	# same-issue hash (md5 of `jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}'` over verdict-derive's
217	# --json output; legacy files hash their findings section).
218	fb_parse() {
219	  local f="$1" g="$2" rel vj tl pj hash
220	  rel="${f#"$root"/}"
221	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then jq -nc --arg f "$rel" '{file: $f, exists: false}'; return 0; fi
222	  vj=$(bash "$VERDICT_DERIVE" --file "$f" --gate "$g" --json 2>/dev/null) || true
223	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$vj" || vj='{"trailer_found":false,"verdict":null,"counts":null,"exit_code":1}'
224	  tl=$(grep -E '^<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$' "$f" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1) || tl=""
225	  pj=$(printf '%s' "$tl" | sed -E 's/^<!-- LOA-VERDICT (.*) -->[[:space:]]*$/\1/')
226	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$pj" || pj='{}'
227	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.trailer_found' <<<"$vj")" == true ]]; then
228	    hash=$(printf '%s\n' "$vj" | jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}' | _md5)
229	  else
230	    hash=$( { grep -A 100 "## Findings\|## Issues\|## Changes Required" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; } | head -50 | _md5)
231	  fi
232	  jq -nc --arg f "$rel" --argjson v "$vj" --argjson p "$pj" --arg h "$hash" '
233	    def sid: if type == "string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$") then . else null end;
234	    def tsv: if type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$") then . else null end;
235	    {file: $f, exists: true, trailer: ($v.trailer_found == true),
236	     verdict: ($v.verdict | if type == "string" then . else null end),
237	     counts: ($v.counts // null), exit_code: ($v.exit_code // 1),
238	     sprint_id: ($p.sprint_id | sid), ts: ($p.ts | tsv), hash: $h}
239	    | .approved = (.exit_code == 0 and .verdict == "APPROVED")'
240	}
241	
242	# impl_commit SINCE → "sha epoch" of the newest non-merge commit on HEAD since
243	# SINCE touching a path outside the state/generated set, or nothing
244	impl_commit() {
245	  git -C "$root" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
246	  git -C "$root" log --no-merges -n 1 --format='%H %ct' ${1:+"--since=$1"} -- . \
247	    ':(exclude,glob)grimoires/**' ':(exclude,glob).run/**' ':(exclude,glob)**/REPO-MAP.md' \
248	    ':(exclude,glob)**/checksums.json' ':(exclude,glob)**/CHANGELOG.md' 2>/dev/null || true
249	}
250	
251	# The ordered rounds of one sprint directory: every -rN file, then the current
252	# file unless it is byte-identical to the highest -rN of its gate
253	rounds_of() {
254	  local dir="$1" g base f n top topn cur
255	  for g in review audit; do
256	    if [[ "$g" == review ]]; then base=engineer-feedback; else base=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
257	    top=""; topn=-1
258	    for f in "$dir/$base"-r*.md; do
259	      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
260	      n=${f##*-r}; n=${n%.md}
261	      [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}$ ]] || continue
262	      fb_parse "$f" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" --argjson n "$((10#$n))" '. + {gate: $g, round: $n}'
263	      if (( 10#$n > topn )); then topn=$((10#$n)); top="$f"; fi
264	    done
265	    cur="$dir/$base.md"
266	    if [[ -f "$cur" ]] && ! { [[ -n "$top" ]] && cmp -s "$cur" "$top"; }; then
267	      fb_parse "$cur" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" '. + {gate: $g, round: 999999}'
268	    fi
269	  done
270	}
271	
272	# Shared jq definitions: time, the breaker recompute and the run-state resolution
273	JQ_DEFS='
274	def epoch: if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
275	def fresh($now; $win): epoch as $t | $t != null and ($now - $t) <= $win and ($t - $now) <= 300;
276	def recompute($rounds; $reset):
277	  ($rounds
278	   | map(select($reset == null or ((.ts // "") > $reset)))
279	   | sort_by([(.ts // ""), .round, (if .gate == "review" then 0 else 1 end)])
280	   | map(select(.approved | not))) as $nr
281	  | reduce $nr[] as $r ({cycle: 0, same: 0, hash: null, np: 0, lc: null};
282	      .cycle += 1
283	      | (if $r.hash != "none" and $r.hash == .hash then .same += 1 else .same = 1 | .hash = $r.hash end)
284	      | ($r.counts | tojson) as $c
285	      | (if .lc != null and .lc == $c then .np += 1 else .np = 0 end)
286	      | .lc = $c);
287	def skeleton($th; $ts):
288	  {state: "CLOSED",
289	   triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: $th.same, last_hash: null},
290	              no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: $th.np},
291	              cycle_count: {current: 0, limit: $th.cycles},
292	              timeout: {started: $ts, limit_hours: $th.hours}},
293	   history: []};
294	def merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts):
295	  (if type == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
296	  | .triggers = (.triggers // {})
297	  | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ([(.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0), $rc.cycle] | max)
298	  | (if $rc.same > (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0)
299	     then .triggers.same_issue.count = $rc.same | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $rc.hash else . end)
300	  | (if $rc.np > (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) or (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts == null and $rc.lc != null)
301	     then .triggers.no_progress.count = ([(.triggers.no_progress.count // 0), $rc.np] | max)
302	          | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $rc.lc else . end)
303	  | ( if (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
304	        then ["same_issue", "same issue hash repeated \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times (derived from the feedback history)"]
305	      elif (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
306	        then ["no_progress", "counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
307	      elif (.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
308	        then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
309	      else null end ) as $trip
310	  | if $trip != null and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
311	    then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], source: "derive"}])
312	    else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end;
313	def known_ids: (.derivation.sprint_ids // null) // ((.sprints.list // []) | map(.id? // empty));
314	def resolve($f; $now; $win):
315	  . as $c
316	  | (if ($c | type) == "object" then $c else {} end) as $c
317	  | ($c.state // $c.status // "") as $cs
318	  | ($c | known_ids) as $known
319	  | ([$f.sprints[] | select(.state != "complete")
320	      | "sprint-\(.global_id)" as $g | .local_label as $l
321	      | select(($known | index($g)) == null and ($l == "" or ($known | index($l)) == null))] | length > 0) as $new
322	  | ((($c.completion // {}) | .merged_sha? // "") | type == "string" and length > 0) as $merged
323	  | if ($c.state // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or ($c.status // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or $merged then "JACKED_OUT"
324	    elif $f.breaker_open or $cs == "HALTED" then "HALTED"
325	    elif $f.all_complete then "COMPLETE"
326	    elif $cs == "COMPLETE" and ($new | not) then "COMPLETE"
327	    elif ($c.timestamps.last_activity? // null) | fresh($now; $win) then "RUNNING"
328	    else "INTERRUPTED" end;
329	'
330	
331	cmd_derive() {
332	  local ledger="$root/grimoires/loa/ledger.json" a2a="$root/grimoires/loa/a2a" active rows
333	  if [[ ! -f "$ledger" ]] || ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
334	    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: no readable ledger at $ledger — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
335	  fi
336	  active=$(jq -r '.active_cycle // empty | strings' "$ledger")
337	  if [[ -z "$active" ]] || ! jq -e --arg c "$active" 'any(.cycles[]?; .id == $c)' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
338	    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: the ledger has no active cycle — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
339	  fi
340	  local win now now_ts fa=1 th
341	  win=$(( $(cfg_int '.run_mode.stale_hours' 12 8760) * 3600 ))
342	  [[ "$(cfg '.run_mode.file_authoritative')" == false ]] && fa=0
343	  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
344	              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
345	              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
346	              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
347	              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
348	  now=$(date +%s); now_ts=$(now_iso)
349	
350	  # Per-sprint facts
351	  local sprints="[]" gid label lstatus since dir rv au mex msid ic sj
352	  rows=$(jq -r --arg c "$active" '
353	    (.cycles[] | select(.id == $c)) as $cy
354	    | ($cy.sprints // [])[]
355	    | select((.global_id | type) == "number")
356	    | [(.global_id | tostring), ((.local_label // "") | tostring), ((.status // "") | tostring),
357	       ([.started, .created, $cy.created] | map(select(type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-")))
358	        | if length == 0 then "" else ([.[0], ($cy.created // "")] | max) end)]
359	    | map(if . == "" then "-" else . end)
360	    | @tsv' "$ledger")
361	  # "-" stands for an empty field: IFS whitespace (tab) would collapse two adjacent separators
362	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r gid label lstatus since; do
363	    [[ "$gid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
364	    [[ "$label" == - ]] && label=""
365	    [[ "$since" == - ]] && since=""
366	    [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ ]] || label=""
367	    [[ "$lstatus" =~ ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ ]] || lstatus="unknown"
368	    [[ "$since" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$ ]] || since=""
369	    dir="$a2a/sprint-$gid"
370	    rv=$(fb_parse "$dir/engineer-feedback.md" review)
371	    au=$(fb_parse "$dir/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" audit)
372	    mex=false; msid=""
373	    if [[ -f "$dir/COMPLETED" ]]; then
374	      mex=true
375	      msid=$(sed -n 's/^sprint:[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9._-]*\).*/\1/p' "$dir/COMPLETED" | head -n 1) || msid=""
376	    fi
377	    ic=$(impl_commit "$since")
378	    sj=$(jq -nc --argjson gid "$gid" --arg label "$label" --arg status "$lstatus" --argjson rv "$rv" --argjson au "$au" \
379	              --argjson mex "$mex" --arg msid "$msid" --arg ic "$ic" '
380	      def mine: type == "string" and length > 0 and (. == "sprint-\($gid)" or ($label != "" and . == $label));
381	      ($rv.approved == true and ($rv.sprint_id | mine)) as $R
382	      | ($au.approved == true and ($au.sprint_id | mine)) as $A
383	      | ([$rv.sprint_id, $au.sprint_id, (if $msid == "" then null else $msid end)] | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0))) as $ids
384	      | ($mex and any($ids[]; mine | not)) as $stale
385	      | ($mex and ($stale | not) and (($rv.sprint_id | mine) or ($au.sprint_id | mine))) as $M
386	      | ($ic | split(" ")) as $c
387	      | ([$rv.ts, $au.ts] | map(select(. != null)) | max) as $vts
388	      | def verdict($x): if $x.exists then {verdict: $x.verdict, sprint_id: $x.sprint_id, consistent: ($x.exit_code == 0), file: $x.file} else null end;
389	      {global_id: $gid, local_label: $label, status: $status,
390	       completed_marker: $M, marker_present: $mex, stale_marker: $stale,
391	       review: verdict($rv), audit: verdict($au),
392	       impl_commit: (if ($c | length) == 2 then $c[0] else null end),
393	       commit_after_verdict: (if ($c | length) == 2 and $vts != null
394	                              then (($c[1] | tonumber) > ($vts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch 0)) else null end),
395	       legacy_feedback: ([$rv, $au] | map(select(.exists and (.trailer | not)) | .file)),
396	       state: (if $M and $R and $A and $status == "completed" then "complete"
397	               elif ($M | not) and $R and $A then "awaiting_marker" else "in_progress" end)}')
398	    sprints=$(jq -c --argjson s "$sj" '. + [$s]' <<<"$sprints")
399	  done <<<"$rows"
400	
401	  # Breaker recompute over the active sprint's ordered rounds
402	  local active_gid rounds cache="null" cache_ok=1 bcache="null" reset rc merged
403	  active_gid=$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "" else ((map(select(.state != "complete")) | .[0]) // .[-1]) | .global_id | tostring end' <<<"$sprints")
404	  rounds="[]"
405	  if [[ -n "$active_gid" && -d "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" ]]; then
406	    rounds=$(rounds_of "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" | jq -sc '.')
407	  fi
408	  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
409	    if cache=$(jq -c . "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [[ -n "$cache" ]]; then :; else cache="null"; cache_ok=0; fi
410	  fi
411	  if [[ -f "$breaker" ]]; then bcache=$(jq -c 'if type == "object" then . else null end' "$breaker" 2>/dev/null) || bcache="null"; [[ -n "$bcache" ]] || bcache="null"; fi
412	  reset=$(jq -c '.reset_at? // null | if type == "string" then . else null end' <<<"$bcache")
413	  rc=$(jq -nc --argjson r "$rounds" --argjson z "$reset" "$JQ_DEFS"' recompute($r; $z)')
414	  merged=$(jq -c --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' <<<"$bcache")
415	
416	  local facts report
417	  facts=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$sprints" --argjson b "$merged" '
418	    {sprints: $s,
419	     all_complete: (($s | length) > 0 and all($s[]; .state == "complete")),
420	     breaker_open: ($b.state == "OPEN"),
421	     stale_markers: [$s[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id)"],
422	     legacy_feedback: [$s[] | .legacy_feedback[]],
423	     sprint_ids: [$s[] | "sprint-\(.global_id)"]}')
424	  report=$(jq -nc --argjson f "$facts" --argjson c "$cache" --argjson b "$merged" --argjson rc "$rc" \
425	                  --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" --arg cycle "$active" \
426	                  --argjson fa "$fa" --argjson cache_ok "$cache_ok" --arg ag "$active_gid" "$JQ_DEFS"'
427	    def st: if type == "string" then (if test("^[A-Z_]{1,32}$") then . else "INVALID" end) else null end;
428	    ($c | resolve($f; $now; $win)) as $s
429	    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.state | st) else null end) as $cs
430	    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.status | st) else null end) as $cst
431	    | {cycle: $cycle, derived_at: $ts, stale_hours: ($win / 3600), file_authoritative: ($fa == 1),
432	       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,
433	       cache: (if $cache_ok == 0 then "unparseable" elif $c == null then "missing" else "present" end),
434	       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
435	       notes: ([
436	         (if $cs != null and $cst != null and $cs != $cst then "cache .state \($cs) and .status \($cst) disagree" else empty end),
437	         (if $s == "JACKED_OUT" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "JACKED_OUT is terminal: files show incomplete sprints; the cache is kept" else empty end),
438	         (if $s == "COMPLETE" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "COMPLETE kept: no new incomplete sprint in the ledger" else empty end),
439	         ($f.sprints[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id): COMPLETED marker names another sprint (stale_marker, not counted)"),
440	         ($f.sprints[] | select(.state == "awaiting_marker") | "sprint-\(.global_id): review and audit APPROVED, no COMPLETED marker")
441	       ]),
442	       sprints: $f.sprints,
443	       active_sprint: (if $ag == "" then null else "sprint-\($ag)" end),
444	       breaker: {state: $b.state, cycle_count: $b.triggers.cycle_count.current, same_issue: $b.triggers.same_issue.count,
445	                 no_progress: $b.triggers.no_progress.count, recomputed: {cycle_count: $rc.cycle, same_issue: $rc.same, no_progress: $rc.np}},
446	       derivation: {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback},
447	       written: false}')
448	
449	  if (( write )); then
450	    local why=""
451	    if (( fa == 0 )); then why="run_mode.file_authoritative: false — report-only"
452	    elif [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then why="no run state at $file — nothing to rewrite"
453	    elif (( cache_ok == 0 )); then why="$file unparseable — kept for inspection, not rewritten"
454	    fi
455	    if [[ -z "$why" ]]; then
456	      atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' || return 3
457	      merged=$(jq -c . "$breaker")
458	      facts=$(jq -c --argjson b "$merged" '.breaker_open = ($b.state == "OPEN")' <<<"$facts")
459	      atomic_update "$file" --argjson f "$facts" --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"'
460	        resolve($f; $now; $win) as $s
461	        | .state = $s | .status = $s | .derived_at = $ts
462	        | .derivation = {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback, sprint_ids: $f.sprint_ids}
463	        | .schema_version = (.schema_version // 2)' || return 3
464	      report=$(jq -c --slurpfile c "$file" --argjson b "$merged" '.written = true | .state = $c[0].state | .breaker.state = $b.state' <<<"$report")
465	    else
466	      report=$(jq -c --arg w "$why" '.notes += [$w]' <<<"$report")
467	    fi
468	  fi
469	
470	  if (( json )); then
471	    jq . <<<"$report"
472	  else
473	    jq -r '"derive: files say \(.state), cache said \(.cache_state // "nothing") (\(if .drift then "drift" else "in sync" end))"
474	           + (if .written then " — caches rewritten" else "" end), (.notes[] | "  note: " + .)' <<<"$report"
475	  fi
476	  return 0
477	}
478	
479	cmd_record_round() {
480	  [[ -n "$gate" && -n "$file" ]] || usage
481	  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: record-round: no feedback file at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
482	  local p th ts now out trip
483	  p=$(fb_parse "$file" "$gate")
484	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.approved' <<<"$p")" == true ]]; then
485	    echo "recorded: $gate APPROVED — breaker counters unchanged"
486	    return 0
487	  fi
488	  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
489	              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
490	              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
491	              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
492	              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
493	  ts=$(now_iso); now=$(date +%s)
494	  atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson p "$p" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$ts" --argjson now "$now" \
495	      --arg gate "$gate" --arg sprint "$sprint" "$JQ_DEFS"'
496	    (if type == "object" and (.triggers | type) == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
497	    | ($p.counts | tojson) as $c
498	    | (if $p.hash != "none" and $p.hash == (.triggers.same_issue.last_hash // null)
499	       then .triggers.same_issue.count = ((.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) + 1)
500	       else .triggers.same_issue.count = 1 | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $p.hash end)
501	    | (if (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts // null) != null and .triggers.no_progress.last_counts == $c
502	       then .triggers.no_progress.count = ((.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) + 1)
503	       else .triggers.no_progress.count = 0 end)
504	    | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $c
505	    | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ((.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) + 1)
506	    | (.triggers.timeout.started // null | epoch) as $start
507	    | ( if .triggers.same_issue.count >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
508	          then ["same_issue", "same issue hash \($p.hash[0:8]) seen \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times in a row"]
509	        elif .triggers.no_progress.count >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
510	          then ["no_progress", "finding counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds"]
511	        elif .triggers.cycle_count.current >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
512	          then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds reached the limit \(.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)"]
513	        elif $start != null and ($now - $start) >= ((.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) * 3600)
514	          then ["timeout", "run older than \(.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) hours"]
515	        elif (.state // "CLOSED") == "OPEN" then ["open", "breaker already OPEN"]
516	        else null end ) as $trip
517	    | .last_round = {gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end), verdict: $p.verdict, hash: $p.hash, ts: $ts}
518	    | if $trip != null and $trip[0] != "open" and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
519	      then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end)}])
520	      elif $trip != null then .state = "OPEN"
521	      else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end
522	    | .last_trip = $trip' || return 3
523	  trip=$(jq -r '.last_trip // empty | if type == "array" then "\(.[0]): \(.[1])" else empty end' "$breaker")
524	  out=$(jq -r '"recorded: \(.last_round.gate) \(.last_round.verdict // "no verdict") — cycle \(.triggers.cycle_count.current)/\(.triggers.cycle_count.limit), same_issue \(.triggers.same_issue.count)/\(.triggers.same_issue.threshold), no_progress \(.triggers.no_progress.count)/\(.triggers.no_progress.threshold)"' "$breaker")
525	  echo "$out"
526	  if [[ -n "$trip" ]]; then
527	    atomic_update "$state_file" --arg ts "$ts" '.state = "HALTED"' || return 3
528	    echo "TRIPPED: $trip"
529	    return 10
530	  fi
531	  return 0
532	}
533	
534	cmd_mark() {
535	  [[ -n "$skill" && -n "$sprint" ]] || usage
536	  mkdir -p "$run_dir"
537	  atomic_update "$run_dir/implement-active.json" --arg k "$skill" --arg s "$sprint" --arg ts "$(now_iso)" \
538	    '{skill: $k, sprint: $s, started_at: $ts}' || return 3
539	  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
540	    local err drc=0
541	    err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
542	    if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
543	  fi
544	  echo "marked: $skill $sprint ($run_dir/implement-active.json)"
545	}
546	
547	case "$sub" in
548	  write)  cmd_write ;;
549	  read)   cmd_read ;;
550	  derive) cmd_derive ;;
551	  record-round) cmd_record_round ;;
552	  mark)   cmd_mark ;;
553	  unmark) rm -f -- "$run_dir/implement-active.json" "$run_dir/implement-active.json.lock"; echo "unmarked" ;;
554	  *) usage ;;
555	esac
